fleetCeremonial.description: Bright ordered Fleet light with readable faces, etched metal, polished surfaces, and restrained memorial warmth.

vergeLivedIn.description: Practical dock and market illumination: lantern amber, worklights, daylight, worn textiles, and clear human-scale detail.

shardIndustrial.description: Bright industrial worklights, forge glow, scarred metal reflections, and controlled ember accents without obscuring faces.

latticeAnomaly.description: Clean readable exposure around impossible geometry, luminous nodes, mirrored or refracted structures, and restrained anomaly glow.

combatReadable.description: High-clarity cinematic combat lighting; motion remains readable and hull/material detail survives explosions and plasma effects.
